entities.summary: Matthew Andrew Banahan is a rugby union coach and former player who played for Bath and Gloucester in Premiership Rugby, between 2006 and 2021. Born in Jersey, he played 20 times for England, receiving 16 caps between 2009 and 2011. His main position was wing; however, he could also operate as an inside or outside centre.
